title: Add recipe scaling helpers
description: Add reusable `RecipeScale` helpers for scaling individual quantities and full recipes without mutating non-ingredient content.
acceptance_criteria: `RecipeScale.scaled(_ quantity:)` scales numeric quantities and leaves text quantities unchanged.
`RecipeScale.scaled(_ recipe:)` returns a copy with all ingredient quantities scaled by factor.
Cookware, timers, text content, metadata, and section structure remain unchanged.
